correctness.rationale: PASS: For rate-one continuous-time 0..L reflecting path with absorbing 0, initial/reset site 2, the Laplace transform hitting recursion (2+r)phi_i=phi_{i-1}+phi_{i+1}, boundary (1+r)phi_L=phi_{L-1}, gives phi_2=D_{L-2}/D_L and renewal M=(1-phi_2)/(r phi_2). D_k coefficients binom(k+j,2j) obey the recurrence, and M(0)=2L-1. Coefficient cancellation makes Q_L=r^(L-1)-sum_{j=1}^{L-3}c_{L,j}r^j, c>0, hence precisely one positive root for L>=4 and no benefit for L=2,3. For L=4 Q=r(r^2-7), so rho_4=sqrt7. The hyperbolic continuant limit m_infty=y(y+1)/(y-1), y+y^-1=2+r, uniquely minimized at y=1+sqrt2, and monotone finite-L control gives convergence of all minimizers. Bounded exact symbolic checks agree for L=2,3,4,5,6,9 and do not prove the infinite statement.
